title: Comparative Genomics and Phylogeny Studies in Nucleic Acids Research
summary: This cluster consists of scientific publications and authors related to comparative genomics and phylogeny studies. The publications include D380, 10.1093 / nar / gkn762, and PMC2686452, which are all linked through authorship and publication relationships. SUPERFAMILY is a publication that was authored by Talbot C. Vogel and published in Acids Res, which in turn was published in D380. The study 19036790 was published in 10.1093 / nar / gkn762, indicating a connection between these publications. The cluster also includes the processes of data mining, phylogeny Nucl, sophisticated comparative genomics, and visualization, which are likely related to the research conducted in these publications.
